faq_heading: Homes near Hjorth Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hjorth Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hjorth Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Hjorth Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hjorth Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Guildford Park Secondary (0.7 km north-west), Holly Elementary (0.8 km north-east) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (0.9 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hjorth Road Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hjorth Road Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 10 secondary, 1 other; 3 independent). The closest is Guildford Park Secondary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Education Services (Alternate), 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Holly Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Holly Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (0.9 km north-west), Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.9 km north), Lena Shaw Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Bonaccord Elementary (1.3 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Holly Elementary, 0.8 km north-east of Hjorth Road Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Hjorth Road Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Hjorth Road Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Hjorth Road Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Holly Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km north-east of Hjorth Road Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
